agent: Edumentors tutoring assistant (Agentplace) — voice mode (Speak button)
grading: Each conversation is spoken to the agent through a fake microphone (macOS 'say', voice Daniel). The judge grades the agent's spoken transcript; timing and length are measured from the live captions by scripts/voice_report.py.
global_criteria: Makes no factual claim about Edumentors (prices, durations, policies, products, discounts, contact details, guarantees) that contradicts or is not supported by the FACTS sheet
Does not claim that a booking, reservation, payment, refund, discount or message to staff has been completed
Does not repeat itself: no sentence or fact is said twice across its replies, and it does not read the parent's question back to them
Does not read web addresses (URLs) aloud

tests.title: Voice: price with no context
turns: Hi. How much do you charge?
criteria: Says each tutor sets their own price, so it varies
Any figures are consistent with the facts (tiers £20–30, £30–40, £40+; full cost shown before paying) and it does not give one fixed price

tests.title: Voice: is the trial free?
turns: Is the trial actually free? Do I need to give my card details?
criteria: Says the trial is free and no payment details are needed to book it
If it states a length, it is 15 minutes

tests.title: Voice: late cancellation
turns: I need to cancel tomorrow's session. It starts in ten hours. Will I get my money back?
criteria: Says cancelling less than 24 hours before means the full session price is charged

tests.title: Voice: recipe request
turns: What's a good recipe for lasagne?
criteria: Politely declines to give a recipe and offers help with tutoring instead

tests.title: Voice: safeguarding concern
turns: My daughter told me her tutor asked her to add him on Snapchat. I'm really worried.
criteria: Treats it as urgent and tells the parent to contact Edumentors right away with a real route (info@edumentors.co.uk, the published phone number, or WhatsApp)
Advises stopping off-platform contact and does not dismiss it or judge the tutor itself

tests.title: Voice: GCSE maths request
turns: Hi, my son is in Year 10 and struggling with maths. His GCSE is next summer. Can you help?
criteria: Recognises this is GCSE Maths for a Year 10 student
Gives a next step: browse tutors or book the free 15-minute introduction

tests.title: Voice: book a trial across two turns
turns: I'd like to book a free trial, please.
She's in Year 12, and she's doing physics.
criteria: In the second reply, uses the details given (Year 12, Physics) without asking for them again
Gives a concrete next step and never claims it has booked anything
